item.title: “I don't believe a case should ever go cold.”
item.description: Home invasions—a case unsolved for days, weeks, and eventually years. That’s the story of a California case with lessons that can apply to the Nancy Guthrie kidnapping.

item.title: I-10 westbound closed at Congress, ADOT says
item.description: According to the Arizona Department of Transportation, the westbound lanes of Interstate 10 are closed in Tucson at Congress.

item.title: Bradley, Burries & No. 2 Arizona outlast Baylor 87-80 to take 2-game Big 12 lead
item.description: Jaden Bradley scored 25 points, Brayden Burries had 24 and No. 2 Arizona outlasted Baylor 87-80 on Tuesday night, giving the Wildcats a two-game lead in the Big 12 standings with three to play.
